compaction.threshold: Claude Code 2.1.312 default auto-compact point of the window (CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE unset)

context_window.set_by: the CLI's own model table for the cell model; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=1000000 also set (a name present in the 2.1.312 binary)

differences_from_pin: runs through Harbor's ClaudeCode class (claude --verbose --output-format=stream-json --print, Harbor's settings file and session dir), not adapter.sh
installed with Harbor's bootstrap.sh route (native binary) instead of npm in our image; the binary's sha256 is checked against the pinned 4f4178ce...
--effort high added (our pin runs the CLI's default effort)
CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS and CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW set to the model's limits (our pin leaves CLI defaults)
no world-MCP server, --mcp-config or --strict-mcp-config: TB2.1 tasks have no MCP server
working directory is the task's, not /workspace

effort.setting: --effort high (CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=high); on Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 thinking is adaptive and always on, so the canonical request is thinking adaptive plus output_config.effort high, checked on captured requests

endpoint.credential: per-trial dummy token trial-token:<trial>.<32 hex>, bound by broker.ts; no provider key in the container

housekeeping_model.note: every model variable the CLI reads (ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL included) names the cell model, as our adapter.sh pins it; a declared deviation from the shipped housekeeping default (internal-task exception, 2026-11-01). On Fable cells the housekeeping calls go to Fable.

model_limits.source: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-11-07 (Context window 1M tokens, Max output 128K tokens, adaptive thinking always on)

tools.enabled: every other built-in Claude Code tool; no MCP server
tools.hosted_web_search: off: --disallowedTools WebSearch,WebFetch and settings permissions.deny [WebSearch, WebFetch], as our pin

compaction.threshold: Codex default (auto_compact_token_limit unset; remote compaction off)

context_window.set_by: config.toml model_context_window=872000, the model's 1050000 capped by Codex 0.165.0's built-in max_context_window (codex-rs/models-manager/models.json, 872,000 for GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra; models-manager/src/model_info.rs with_config_overrides takes the smaller). Declared harness behaviour: only model_catalog_json lifts the cap, and a custom catalog also changes Codex's prompt (update_plan instructions, multi-agent and collaboration-mode hints)

differences_from_pin: runs through Harbor's Codex class (codex exec --json with Harbor's flags and an auth.json holding the per-trial token), not adapter.sh; no --strict-config
model_context_window set to the window Codex allows for the model, 872,000 (our pin: Codex default 272,000)
provider env_key OPENAI_API_KEY (our pin: HE_MODEL_API_KEY); the value is the per-trial token in both
no world-MCP server; working directory is the task's

effort.setting: model_reasoning_effort, plan_mode_reasoning_effort and agents.default_subagent_reasoning_effort = high (and -c model_reasoning_effort=high); sent as reasoning.effort

endpoint.credential: per-trial dummy token trial-token:<trial>.<32 hex>, bound by broker.ts; no provider key in the container

housekeeping_model.note: every model-valued config key (review, realtime, subagent, memories) is the cell model, as our pin

max_output_tokens.set_by: the metering proxy writes max_output_tokens 128000 into every /v1/responses request (Codex 0.165.0 sends none), as our pin's deviation says

model_limits.source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol, read 2026-11-07 (1,050,000 context window, 128,000 max output tokens)

tools.hosted_web_search: off: web_search = disabled, tools.web_search = false, capabilities.external_web_access = false, as our pin
